claim: Dated native counter snapshots retain RTK output, the capped Headroom ledger result, per-conversion TOON estimates and three separate Context Mode runtime scopes without treating them as exact provider savings.
limitations: This historical snapshot is a dated report only, not a live dashboard or new-host execution acceptance.
RTK counters estimate retained command history and default to 90-day retention; selected-project values are a subset of the global result. Do not add snapshots or assume a forever ledger.
Headroom 0.37.0 caps the report at 30 days despite naming a field lifetime; zero ledger calls do not establish zero offline guard use or provider usage.
Context Mode uses byte/event heuristics and separate runtime state. Illustrative cost estimates are not bills, and persisted files must not be added to a direct MCP connection snapshot.

TOON statistics are tokenx heuristics for one conversion, not a native cumulative ledger. The compact-JSON exact counterexample is represented by the separate catalog receipt and must not be counted twice.
Raw private files, host paths, full command outputs and session identifiers are omitted. Sanitized fields and aggregate hashes do not independently attest provider activity.
